title: Unified Potato Theory (UPT) — April 18, 2025 Recovery
status: high-priority conversation archaeology; user-originated physical-unification proposal with later mathematical repair; not a validated physical theory
abstract: Unified Potato Theory (UPT) is the earliest currently recovered Tim Dooley proposal that attempts to place a new Potato sector inside an explicit field-theory action. The recovered skeleton combines Einstein gravity, the Standard Model, a Potato field P with a fractional/nonlocal kinetic operator, a proposed U(1)_potato × Z6 symmetry, matter/Higgs interactions and schematic higher-curvature/quantum-gravity sectors. The scientifically tractable core is not the claim that one expression already unifies physics, biology and consciousness; it is the narrower question of whether a mathematically consistent additional scalar/gauge sector with a specified nonlocal kinetic term can be defined as an effective field theory, reduced to known physics in a controlled limit, and made to predict observable deviations. The present record therefore separates the recovered historical Lagrangian from two gauge-consistent completion forks, requires an explicit definition of the fractional operator and cutoff, and treats cross-scale biological/neural claims as a separate coarse-graining problem. UPT is presently a T2 research sketch: algebraically suggestive, historically important to the project, but incomplete in field content, operator definition, stability, renormalization, parameter estimation and discriminating predictions.
research_question: Can the recovered Potato-sector action be completed into a self-consistent effective field theory whose new degrees of freedom, symmetries and nonlocal dynamics produce quantitatively distinguishable effects while recovering GR + the Standard Model in an appropriate limit?
importance: This is currently the earliest recovered concrete Tim physical-unification proposal with an explicit field, symmetry group, Lagrangian and interaction terms. It predates the April 21 Spiral Equation attestation and the May 2026 M-theory synthesis.
provenance_rule: Preserve the recovered UPT formula and concepts as user-originated where conversation memory explicitly attributes them to Tim. Treat explanatory wording, validation plans, gauge-consistent repairs and later completions as assistant/conversation-developed unless a verbatim primary transcript is recovered.
maturity: T2 mathematical/research sketch; not yet a calibrated or predictive physical model

equation_context.status: recovered-project skeleton; several terms are schematic placeholders rather than a complete action
equation_context.dimensional_warning: In four spacetime dimensions a canonical scalar has mass dimension 1. A fractional operator Box^alpha has mass dimension 2 alpha, so its coefficient/field normalization must be chosen explicitly if the action density is to have mass dimension 4. The recovered expression omits that normalization.
equation_context.operator_warning: Fractional powers of the Lorentzian d'Alembertian are not defined by notation alone. A serious model must specify a spectral, Euclidean-continuation, causal kernel or other precise prescription, including branch choice, self-adjointness/hermiticity and boundary conditions.
equation_context.nonlocal_factor: Box^alpha(1+ell^2/Box) should be expanded and dimensionally audited only after the definition of Box^alpha and the role of ell are fixed; otherwise apparent cancellations or pole structure can be misleading.
equation_context.eft_interpretation: The safest current interpretation is as an effective field theory valid below a declared cutoff Lambda, not as a UV-complete Theory of Everything.
equation_context.correspondence_limit: A viable completion should reduce continuously to GR + the Standard Model when Potato-sector couplings are taken to zero and any extra fields are decoupled.

field_theory_consistency_questions: Does the quadratic kinetic operator produce only acceptable poles/residues in the regime where the EFT is claimed to apply?
Is the Hamiltonian bounded or otherwise stable in the chosen prescription?
Is the vacuum of V(P) or V(Phi_P,H) stable or metastable on the required timescale?
Are all interaction operators invariant under SU(3)xSU(2)xU(1)_Y and the chosen Potato symmetry?
What is the renormalization/matching prescription and which coefficients run with scale?
Which parameters are actually identifiable from proposed measurements?

observable_program.principle: Do not test 'UPT as everything' in one step. Test one completed sector against the corresponding established baseline.

particle_branch.baseline: Standard Model or SM + ordinary singlet/gauge extension

nonlocal_branch.baseline: local scalar EFT with the same field content

cross_scale_branch.rule: Biological or neural data require an explicit coarse-graining map from microscopic Potato-sector variables to measured biological variables; shared vocabulary is not a coupling mechanism.

falsification_and_failure_conditions: A chosen completion is rejected if it is mathematically inconsistent in its claimed regime, for example unavoidable negative-norm/unstable modes or an unbounded potential without a stated EFT resolution.
A parameter region is rejected when it conflicts with relevant experimental/observational constraints after the same observables are computed consistently.
A proposed UPT effect loses empirical motivation if it is statistically indistinguishable from a simpler baseline after complexity is penalized.
The broad cross-scale unification claim remains unsubstantiated until explicit inter-scale maps generate successful predictions in more than one domain.

completion_path: 1. Recover primary transcript and freeze the historical skeleton separately from modern repairs.
2. Choose exactly one minimal field-content fork.
3. Define the fractional/nonlocal operator and action with consistent dimensions.
4. Derive vacuum, propagators, masses, interactions and correspondence limits.
